response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS d1, AVG(L.APTT - L.PT) AS d2 FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(d1) AS a1, AVG(d2) AS a2 FROM p GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(a2) AS mean2 FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.a1) AS avg_alb_tp, AVG(s.a2) AS avg_aptt_pt, AVG(s.a2) - m.mean2 AS exceed FROM s CROSS JOIN m WHERE s.a2 > m.mean2
